title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Solo #12 (대각 띠·물결 | 코이비늘+드래곤비늘+목재)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Hawaiian woman, an adult, in her early 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a chin-length bob, real pores, real living eyes, 3 clicker rings piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a bracelet. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
